notes.title: Grab the powerup! minigame update
notes.notes:
New minigame: Grab the powerup! An arena style game where platforms fall over time and grabbing the soda powerup will give the player a big boost to push the rest of the players off. Online sync seems good and the only thing it seems to need is more aggresive AI which will be tweaked during this next week along with some general fixes.

Also:
- Fixed an issue in which you could not select a minigame in offline practice and custom online because new text in front of the preview images would prevent it.

notes.title: Construction Site minigame update
notes.notes:
New minigame: Construction Site, get those concrete bags to your spot and steal them from other players by rolling into them!.

https://i.postimg.cc/KjWBnrxx/mini35game.gif

- Important fix: Fixed an issue in which volumetric lighting would not be visible inany game that implied using it (like Solar Energy).
- New steam achievement for Abducting and Scoring minigame.
- Reduced Blind curse area size even more.
- Increased Cannon Frenzy minigame pace. (Increased cannon blast effect area and force)
- Fixed a small issue in Forklift madness related to online syncing.

Delayed for next version due to sync problem: new type of tile in which moves either the food vendor or the sheriff in their respective boards.

Known issue to fix for next version: players changing their speed permanently after a particular series of events/pressed keys.

notes.title: Menu rework update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- Images when a minigame is selected are replaced with small gameplay videos (more descriptive)
- Reworked menu style. (May change colors though)
- Testing better collision detection for the golf balls, they should not got through geometry anymore with high speeds.
- Implemented basic online collisions in Golf Islands.

- Some characters would get stuck in a small slope in Non-Stop Running minigame, fixed.
- Fixed a small issue when clicking Configure Controls inside Players Config menu.

notes.title: Golf minigame Update
notes.notes:
Changelog:
- A new golf minigame (Missing features list on bottom).
- Improvements to the abducting minigame.
- Reduced the arena size of Blind Curse to spice the minigame up. (Will probably reduce it more)
- Modified the corner lamps in Blind Curse so players cannot climb on them.
- Fixed wrong minigame description in spanish localization.
- Fixed an issue in Basket It! in which local players were not being able to move their aim horizontally.

- Giraffe character would stop a small moment after rolling. Fixed.

https://i.postimg.cc/kGRD4bVk/Full-AP-MG34.gif

Missing features/known issues about the new minigame: (to be implemented/fixed this week)

notes.title: Abducting and Scoring minigame update
notes.notes:
New version features some fixes and a new minigame available for public testing o/

Changelog for new version:
- Added chinese localization for missing strings.
- Fixed wrong name shop in Western board.
- Increased arrows event speed In Western board.
- Sometimes platforms in Lava Parkour would decide to not carry the player with them, implemented a new behaviour for this and hopefully the issue won't appear anymore.
- Improved bot behaviour in Bombing Garden minigame, they will not get stuck as often.
- Added a laser sound to One, Two, Freeze! minigame turrets.
- New minigame: Abducting and Scoring!

notes.title: Western Land Board Update
notes.notes:
After some days of public testing new board is officially implemented. Note this is one of the most intensive boards in terms of objects/behaviours quantity so please report in case of negative performance problems.

New features:
- Multiple ways and paths to select from.
- Day progression system: night will arrive during the last turns of the game and money (or penalties) will be increased. (Night should be more intensive in terms of performance)
- Four news events: train movement, bank robbery, arrows shooting and free sarsaparilla on saloon.
- Simple minimap implementation so players can see their global position and where to go. (also in Station board)
- Remaining moves during a player turn will now show above their heads. (also in Station board)

Board hotfixes:
- Fixed? an issue in which the train event would glitch and would never stop going. Report if this happens again.
- Fixed a possible game-breaking bug happening when the train runs over a player (it would reference a wrong behaviour).
- The behaviour related to bots buying items from shop had some problems, solved.
- Added more speed to the arrows event (3x)

notes.title: Build 0.45 Release
notes.notes:
New game plus fixes while waiting for the new board.

- New minigame: Wrecking Rock
- Fixed the teleporting effect in Hexagon Island, which was a bit offsetted.
- Added some minor extra detail to Hexagon Island.
- AI in Solar Power is now easier.
- Game will now exit automatically if in online mode the host disconnects or if there are not human players left in the match.
- AI in West Gold won't be as persistent is it now in chasing players, will attack other bots more often.
- Fixed? an issue in which a player would show wrong skin in an online game resulting in a horrible character color tone. If this does happen to anyone again, please report so I can further debug the problem. (Rejoining the lobby should fix it since it seems to be a desyncing bug)

Work continues in the new board: it's one of the most complete so far, with branching paths and a dynamic system of day/night.
https://i.postimg.cc/C5QGsqgL/Full-AP-West-Board.png

notes.title: Build 0.44 Release
notes.notes:
Mainly a bug-fixing update. Some were already released as hotfixes due to them being either annoying or even game-breaking. Hexagon Island is receiving some repairing love. Also continuing works in new board.

0.44 changelog:
- Almost all minigames camera intros are now much smoother and will properly aim to players.
- Fixed an AI bug in Filming Action in which bots would get stuck running in a random direction.
- Fixed a heavy bug in Glass Fortress in which screen would be all white and minigame wouldn't run (basically because somehow the level decided to disappear in the compilation) Released as hotfix.
- Online players (clients) would not score on One, Two, Freeze! due to a synchronization problem, it should be solved (thanks to Ardrox and VindeeR).
- Fixed a bug in which special score after playing Ink Spheres would persist in other minigames of the same type (like the race one) resulting in breaking that next game.
- Fixed a game-breaking bug in Hexagon Island in which online players would be unable to send events due to a duplicated network ID (somehow a value reseted to default and broke it). Released as hotfix.
- Fixed a small bug in which bots would not apply bonus money if they are interested in commerces when trading with them.
- Fixed the green teleport effect in Glass Fortress (was a bit offsetted)
- Fixed an issue related to online players showing wrong score (requires testing).
- Due to the increasing number of minigames the rotating method of choosing a game in intermission is getting bugged depending on screen resolution. A new method has been implemented.
- Improved moving animations in Hexagon Island, players now stick more to ground when moving around the board.
- Fixed an issue in Hexagon Island in which some buildings were showing third upgrade tier when only second tier was acquired.
- Fixed another issue in Hexagon Island in which you could buy any property from a bot even if you had not enough money or were in negative numbers. (Report if there's any further inconvenience with this)

notes.title: Build 0.43 Release
notes.notes:
New minigame and minor content addition to several trials.

0.43 changelog:

notes.title: Build 0.42 Release
notes.notes:
0.42 changelog
- New cool minigame: Glass Fortress.
- Improved bots AI in the racing minigame, they are now more of a challenge depending on their selected skill and won't get stuck as often.

notes.title: Build 0.41 Release
notes.notes:
Fixes and a new minigame available for testing.

- New minigame: One, Two, Freeze!
- Improved collision detection in the forklift minigame, this should further prevent vehicles getting stuck with each other but a new behaviour is probably required programmed from zero.

notes.title: Early Access 0.40 Board Update
notes.notes:
Lunar Station has fully arrived! An arcade board which takes place on a moon facility consisting of several biomes habitats. The objective of the game is moving around the board while acquiring batteries from the vendors. There are four types of tiles: Blue (get money), Red (subtract money), green (event: change the position of barriers) and yellow (shops and other minor events). Two shops are available with six different items, check notes for 0.39 and 0.40 for a description. 

Minor issues may appear here and there, feel free to report them!

Version 0.38 Changelog
- Creation of base board for Lunar Station. (So much work in so few words)
- Implementation of the needed changes in main menu to allow board selection, both in offline and offline modes.
- Implementation of the needed changes in board scripts to allow a more arcade gameplay compared to Hexagon Island (P.e. dices not allowing a double turn or boards allowing several directions).
- Implementation of blue and red tiles, which will give or take money from the player respectively. 
- Implementation of event tiles which will allow more dynamic boards (In the case of Lunar Station, the board events will cycle the barriers present in the game which will force players’ direction). Future boards will have more varied events.
- Implementation of battery buying behaviours, vendor relocation when one battery is acquired, etc.
- Made changes to Lunar Station UI to reflect the batteries each player owns.
- Implementation of a winner event at the end of the selected turns.

Version 0.39 Changelog
- Basic AI (bots) implementation.
- Implementation of the needed interactable menus in Lunar Station: use item, player selection for certain items targeting, battery buy event, keycard use event and both shops navigation.
- Implementation of the first shop and all the scripting behind item use and online synchronization.
- Implementation of the first three items in Lunar Station and all the derived scripting behaviours from them:
      - A smoothie drink which will allow a player to increase the dice result by 4 (may change it and make it random between 1-6, like throwing an extra dice)
      - A sour lime drink which will allow a player to select another player and decrease their dice result by 3.
      - A quantum drink which will teleport a player directly to a battery spot, note that it costs 1.5k money and players should still have the required money for buying the battery (2k).

Version 0.40 Changelog
- Implementation of at least some basic UI events when using an item.
- Implementation of a second shop in the top-right part of the board.
- Implementation of three new items:
      - A barrier control device which will allow a player to cycle the board’s barriers at the start of a turn.
      - A golden magnet which will allow a player to steal a battery from another player (it’s expensive though)
      - A keycard item. (Read below)
- Implementation of a central bridge in Lunar Station which can be accessed with the keycard item, this new path will allow a player to roll a machine for a chance to win something good (inclusive a whopping battery!)
- AI will buy and use items somehow wisely.

Changes not related to board:
- Implementation of a more solid behaviour for Lava Parkour and Samurai Climb which should fix the players sometimes disappearing issue. 
- Fixed an issue in Bombing Garden in which AI would crash when grabbing the roll restore item. 
- Fixed non-working energy backpacks of new characters in Solar Energy. 
- Implemented new AI for Sky Pillars which feels more organic but will require some tweaking. Also want to give this minigame a graphic face wash soon 
- Fixed wrong teleporting effect in Hexagon Island.
- Camera won't rotate anymore when a minigame starts but will still approach a player. This change was implemented due to some motion sickness complaints. Related to this expect some smooth camera animations at the start of each minigame soon.
- Fixed an issue in which players would move when paused in games like Roll and Roll or the rolling wheels of Lava Parkour.

-Known issues: 
Players getting stuck with other players in the forklift minigame when they steal furniture.

notes.title: New Board Public Release
notes.notes:
New board is now available for public testing: Lunar Station. This one is more arcade in terms of gameplay compared to Hexagon Island: tile-based events and items to be acquired. The main objective in this case is to gather the most batteries from the vendor machines before the end of the game.

Remaining changes to implement this week are:
- A second vendor machine located on top of the board with the following items:
    - A barrier control item: an item that will allow to cycle the barriers, with the same result of landing a green tile.
    - A golden magnet: allows to steal one battery from the chosen player (expensive though!)
    - A keycard that allows access to a secondary area.

- Effects for items use.
- Secondary area to be accessed with the keycard.
- Bots configuration for items use.
- Maybe a map for general use.

New version also includes some fixes: 
- Implemented online collisions for Ink Spheres minigame. (and improved collisions overall, players will push more when landing a direct hit to other player in the direction they're rolling).
- Bots in Ink Spheres will try to get droplets instead of just wandering around covering the most possible surface area. They will also try to push other players depending on their selected skill.
- Implemented a more solid behaviour for Lava Parkour and Samurai Climb which should fix the players sometimes disappearing issue.

notes.title: Build 0.36 Release
notes.notes:
- New cool minigame: Ink Spheres! (Bots will have a better behaviour during this week and online collisions have to be implemented)
- Players are now able to trade commerces with bots too in Hexagon Island (was not implemented due to a mistake).
- Increased physics steps number for the racing minigame, this should fix the stutters when steering at the cost of a bit more of processing power. It will be balanced further if the processing power increase is too much.
- Fixed the welcoming message which was mistakenly set to a non-readable black color. (Thanks to Tino Huber)
- During pause time (offline mode since the game doesn't pause in online) physics have been modified to not halt with the main time parameter. Glitches like players, bots and other objects suddenly being launched towards sky will probably disappear (requires testing).
- Fixed a critical bug in which an online player would desync on start because it will try to join board mode when minigames mode was chosen.

Content updates will probably be a bit more silent because I want to rush the next board, hotfixes and improvements will still be arriving.

notes.title: Early Access 0.35 Release
notes.notes:
- Implemented 8 new characters: Bully the Bull, Croco the Crocodile, Trunky the Elephant, Ollie the Giraffe, Nugget the Hamster, Bogel the Hippo, Cecil the Lion and Tony the Tiger.
- Implemented two new music tracks.
- Implemented Japanese localization.
- Implemented German localization (note that future updates to localizations will arrive in packs since the translators in task require at least around 400-500 words to work with, meanwhile new texts will be in English).

- Fixed an issue with AI in Blind Curse in which bots would still chase a player even when outside the sphere range.

- Fixed a problem in which the last button pressed would be highlighted even when restarting in bot trading menu in Hexagon Island.
- Fixed an AI behaviour bug in Dangerous Rift which would cause bots to chase players from a great distance and then fall.
- During turn limits matches in Hexagon Island, winner will be decided taking into account the properties of a player too instead of just the remaining money.

Known issues: bots getting stuck in racing minigame as well as some weird steering in players cars (especially if using keyboard controls). Please keep the bug reports incoming since they help to track and fix problems.

notes.title: Early Access 0.34 Release
notes.notes:
- AI improvements:
- Implemented Aftermath Crosshair for AI in some trials. Bots will now use the bouncy balls against other players while jailed.
Nº 2: Iceberg: bots will now pose a fair fight on top of the iceberg instead of trying to stay in the central platform. Also reduced the chance of bots to get stuck when pushed out of the top and try to climb again.

Stay frosty for next update: new characters, new music tracks and new localizations. New board is being worked on, should arrive during July.

notes.title: Early Access 0.33 Release

Big improvements to the racing minigame:

  * Basic AI (will implement some rubber banding as it is decently easy to beat)
  * Using Roll, Jump or Action buttons to control car functions. Roll: use item, Jump: Accelerate, Action: braking.

  * Four pickable items:

Feel free to suggest any extra item that you would like to see in this trial.

notes.title: Early Access 0.32 Release

notes.title: Early Access 0.31 Release
notes.notes:
Content release 0.31:

- Implemented a new minigame: Filming Action. The closest players to the moving camera will earn more points, using a pose grants even more!
- Implemented trading with bots in Hexagon Island, it works a bit different from trading for a player: have to select one of the player properties or one of the bots' properties and it will show an offer depending on the bots' skill and if it needs the property for boosting purposes.
- Added an indicator to remind selected turn limit too.
- Fixed the case when selecting a player in trade menu and main player name was just showing as "Username".
- Minigame 01 - Nine Colors: improvements to AI, bots will now be more aggressive over time and depending on their selected skill in bot configuration. (hard -> most aggressive)
- Fixed an issue in which player selected to trade with (right one in trade menu) would show wrong rent values next to his properties.

For chinese speaking players, second batch of translation is arriving as soon as the person in charge has the file ready (probably tomorrow).

notes.title: Early Access 0.30 Board Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=VHhH_dK1dzc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hexagon Island final update was uploaded last week but no official announcement has been published until some problems were fixed. Here it is:

Merged main development branch with board branch resulting in version 0.3. Changes are too many to enumerate (full list can be found in Updates channel) but the most important ones are:

- Implementation of double turn behaviour when getting the same number on both dices (can only happen once per turn).
- Owning all properties of the same color should provide the owner with a 50% extra rent value on those properties.
- You can now trade properties to other human players in exchange of money or properties (menu will start appearing from turn 3 onwards).
- You can now upgrade properties without having to land on them (menu will start appearing from turn 3 onwards).
- Another settable win condition: negative currency, instead of turn limits, a player will win when all the other players currency is below zero (can still play and recover to positive numbers).

Being able to trade properties with bots as well has been requested and will be added as soon as possible.

Note that final update means main content changes just related to Hexagon Island, glitch fixing and  minor additions can of course be requested as well as suggestions related to how to improve the economy in this particular board (like, should any particular minigame score be nerfed because it provides too much money to the player winning it? should any property have a better rent income?)

As mentioned in other posts and events, feel free to reach me using the email or channels listed in the Discussion forums.

notes.title: Early Access Pre-Board Update
notes.notes:
Howdy! Took some time to prepare core programming for boards but first one is almost completed. Note that while tested, plenty of issues may appear, reach me and I'll address them as soon as possible.
Hexagon Island is now implemented in its early stages for those players who want to give it a go.

It's a property and commerces buying board, if players land on any of your properties they will have to pay you a certain amount of money depending on how upgraded that property is. Every turn a minigame will be played and the score of each player will be added to their respective money amount.

Note that depending on testings, economy will have to be iteratively tweaked until it results in fair games.

I'll implement this week the remaining upgrades to this board, which are:
- Currently owning all properties of the same color does nothing, in the future it will provide a player with an extra rent value on those buildings.
- Being able to negotiate/trade your properties to other players.
- More settable winning conditions. (Instead of turn limit, winning when all players except one go negative p.e.)
- Almost all tiles other than properties do nothing, have plans for them and will change soon.
- An UI notification which shows which player payed money and which one received it.
- Repeat turn if getting same number on both dices.

Once these upgrades are implemented and tested, I'll proceed to upload the full version to Steam as a major update. Estimated time: 24th-25th May.

Next board will be something more arcade (just tile and dice events instead of property buying), it will take less time to arrive especially since the base code is mostly done.

Non-board related stuff to focus on too:
- Reports notified on Discord.
- Improvement of bots in all trials.
- Improve UI in Main Menu (that button for selecting offline/online modes and such)

- Added the second Steam achievement: resisting 150 seconds in Nine Colors minigame (good luck).

notes.title: Early Access 0.15 release
notes.notes:
- Added a new minigame: Blind Curse

- Added a first iteration of chinese localization, thanks to SHAO, LIANGZHEN

- Antialiasing has now been added as an option to be turned on and off. It is recommended to leave it on and only deactivate it if there's any screen glitch (only probable in very old computers)

- Corrected a bug where local players (not main player) would have their camera locked when turning options on and off.

- Fixed a bug in which minigames descriptions wouldn't sometimes fit in screen.

- Local Mode Preferences has been added in Options, you will be able to choose your preference (splitscreen or single camera) for any minigame that allows it (some won't support it due to their mechanics, like the shooting one).

- Splitscreen Optimization has been added in Options, a secondary graphics quality can be selected apart from primary which will only be effective during splitscreen.

- Added a first iteration of QoL in Nine Colors minigame, QoL enhancements are disabled by default and must be enable from options graphics tab.

- Added a cooldown circle around aftermath items (ball, smoke throwers, etc)

- Fixed some navigation problems in main options screen when using a controller or keyboard arrows.

- Received some reports about some music tracks having problems in Youtube because even if they are licensed, some authors have their music content registered there and feeding every youtube streamer the respective permissions would be inconvenient . Implemented an option in audio settings to change the music pack to a Youtube special one which shouldn't give any kind of problem while the conflictive tracks are replaced in the future.

- Bots can now be added in online mode, however they will remain quiet in non-implemented trials (they're being added there!).
